meta.title: Albion Online Crafting Calculator
meta.description: Albion Online crafting calculator: material cost, resource return, focus, station fee, taxes and net revenue per item, with shareable links.
meta.appDescription: Calculates material cost, resource return, station fee, taxes and net revenue for an Albion Online item.
meta.headerDescription: Pick an item and adjust prices, premium, focus and city. Every step of the math is visible.
meta.dataSource: Market data: Albion Online Data Project.

search.placeholder: Search item: potion, staff, cape, mount…
search.failed: Search failed. Check your connection and keep typing to retry.

errors.loadFailed: Couldn't load the item. Check your connection and try again.

plans.title: Plans
plans.signInToSave: Sign in with Discord to save this calculation.
plans.signInToView: Sign in with Discord to save your calculations and come back to them anytime.
plans.empty: You haven't saved any yet. Set up a calculation and use "Save" in the balance.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.stationFeeTip: Silver the station charges for every 100 nutrition your craft uses. The station owner sets it, and you see it in game as the usage fee.
conditions.noSellPrice: No recent sell price for this quality and market. Type one in by hand to calculate.

materials.title: Materials
materials.returnTip: Share of the materials the game gives back when you craft (resource return). It rises with the city bonus and with focus; artifacts are never returned.

ledger.title: Balance
ledger.announce: {negative, select, yes {Profit minus {amount}} other {Profit {amount}}}{incomplete, select, yes {, incomplete} other {}}
ledger.unpriced: {count, plural, one {# material without a price counts} other {# materials without a price count}} as 0.
ledger.fillIn: Fill in what's missing so the profit is real.
ledger.whereFrom: Where the sell price comes from
ledger.repin: Pin this one instead of the previous
ledger.method: Resource return, station fee and taxes: <link>how it's calculated</link>.

compare.incomplete: One of the two has incomplete data; don't take it as a real comparison.

sellSource.manual: You're using a hand-typed price; the quotes are for reference only.
sellSource.none: There are no recent quotes for this quality and market.
sellSource.median: Median of {count} {count, plural, one {market} other {markets}} (quality Q{quality}). Quotes far from the median are discarded.
sellSource.outlier_self: far from that city's own 30-day average

empty.title: What will you craft?
empty.body: Search for an item and adjust tier, enchantment, city and prices. The balance shows where every number comes from.
